assets.prompt: Use case: compositing / product-mockup. Create ONE finished photorealistic editorial website card background, landscape 3:2. Input image 1 is the exact real Le Labo Santal 33 product reference; input image 2 is the exact real Byredo Bal d'Afrique product reference; image 3 is ONLY a color and lighting reference, do NOT copy its imaginary bottles. Place the two REAL bottles from images 1 and 2 together on the lower RIGHT half of a deep black-cherry burgundy matte studio tabletop, background #681E36, dark #390E22 corners with restrained warm rose reflected highlights. Preserve each original bottle faithfully: Santal tall cylindrical glass body, cylindrical brushed silver cap, cream printed laboratory label reading SANTAL 33 and LE LABO; Byredo broad short cylindrical glass, glossy black rounded dome cap, white label reading BYREDO / BAL D'AFRIQUE. Preserve original proportions, pale liquids, label placement and actual silhouettes. Both upright, front labels toward viewer, clearly distinct, harmonious scale (Santal somewhat taller), fine realistic contact shadows. Bottles occupy x=54-94%, y=37-88%; upper third and left half quiet clean burgundy negative space for website white text. Do not create any UI, headings, buttons or text beyond original product labels. No invented perfume packaging, extra bottles, branches, stones, wood, gold decoration, borders or watermarks. Sophisticated modern fragrance photography, tactile matte background, controlled studio light, recognizably real products, not generic AI bottle designs.
